title: Loud Fart
blurb: The loud fart — same joke as the regular fart, but with conviction. This one isn't sneaking past anyone: it's a full-volume, room-stopping declaration. Deploy when subtlety has failed, when the moment demands commitment, or when you need to end a conversation immediately and forever. Pairs beautifully with a slow dramatic zoom or the Vine Boom for maximum cinema.
origin: The fart, but louder. Escalation is a valid comedic strategy.
